detail.longDescription: New on the blog: ArtCraft is rebuilding Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere, Word, Excel and more in Rust, with AI coding agents. I tried it. PhotoCraft actually handled my video thumbnails, apps start in 1-2 seconds, and there are native # FreeBSD builds. The more interesting part: GUI, CLI and agents drive the same engine. And when code gets cheap, verification becomes the bottleneck. https:// blog.hofstede.it/artcraft-rust -agent-desktop-apps/ # RustLang # OpenSource # AI # AIAgents # Linux # FOSS
